errors.claim: Which Major Country Has the Highest Savings Rate?
errors.reason: Qatar is ranked #1 in the dataset with 59.5%, but calling it a major country based solely on this dataset or general size is subjective/unsourced framing, though the primary factual check relies on the superlative. Qatar is indeed #1.

errors.claim: China is the odd one out, saving 43%.
errors.reason: China's savings rate of 43% is correct, but 'odd one out' is an unsourced narrative claim.

claims.text: Qatar saves 59.5% of its national income.
The USA saves 16.8%, while the UK saves 17.3%.
China is the odd one out, saving 43%.
At the opposite end, East Timor is down 18.5%.

title.reason: Qatar is highest at 59.5%, though 'major' is framing.

description.reason: Accurately describes World Bank gross savings rate data.

beat_1.reason: Lists USA, UK, and China, matching the visual plan.

beat_2.reason: USA (16.8%) and GBR (17.3%) match the data values.
